research_rationale:
EO 8083 independently extends retirement coverage, replaces Rule II section 3(d), and supersedes EO 3375, all effective May 1, 1939. Complete official page 1577 and EO 9830 Parts I–III were read; images of original page 1 and actor pages 1,4,5,11 were inspected. EO 9830 names 8083 without exception in Part III, under the opening global effective date May 1, 1947. January 24, 1942 statutory coverage revision and EO 9154 exclusions are earlier functional replacement candidates, disclosed under the owner ruling on unnamed instruments, not earlier formal ends of this named order. Wartime recruitment and 1946 transitional rules do not erase all earlier status rights. Historical supersession, completed appointments and accrued retirement or status rights are distinguished from continuing commands of revoked 8083.

Service Rule H 1  is hereby amended to 
read as follows:
“The proper appointing officer may 
fill any position named in Schedule A 
or Schedule B, or any other excepted 
position, as classified positions are filled, 
in which case the person so appointed 
shall be eligible for transfer, reinstate­
ment, or promotion to positions in the 
classified service, subject to the provi­
sions of these rules. The encumbent of 
any excepted position so filled will not 
be entitled to protection against re­
moval afforded by these rules.”
The issuance of this order is recom­
mended by the Civil Service Commisison.
